ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food web, what will happen to crabs and limpets if all the algae died due to pesticides?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with “algae” (algae) at the bottom center, and seagrass, plankton, etc. beside it; the red arrows in the diagram indicate food sources pointing to the animals that eat them. According to the arrows starting from near the algae in the diagram, algae have a feeding relationship with crabs and limpets. Reasoning: If all algae die because of pesticides, then crabs and limpets that rely on algae as a food source will lose food or have less food, so their numbers will decrease.
